response.original_title: (Guest!@Reservation) How to add another passenger or guest to Existing Carnival Cruise Reservation?
response.overview: Adding another guest to an existing booking ＋1-877-619-8065(US) with Carnival Cruises is possible in many situations, but the process depends on several factors such as the type of reservation,＋1-877-619-8065(US) or ＋1-877-619-8065(US) cabin capacity, availability on the sailing, and how close you are to the departure date. Many travelers decide to add a friend, ＋1-877-619-8065(US) spouse, or family member after they have already made their cruise reservation, ＋1-877-619-8065(US) and Carnival generally allows this as long as there is space available in the stateroom ＋1-877-619-8065(US) or ＋1-877-619-8065(US) and the booking has not reached the final documentation stage.
